# Functional-gate candidate fixtures

Each `<mode>__<label>/parts.dxf` is **Refab Artist's own output**: the DXF the
headless exporter writes for that case, which is the file the app's Export
command writes for the same plan. They are project-owned test evidence,
committed so the functional-correctness gate
(`tests/gates/test_functional_gate.py`, `scripts/functional_gate.py`) can run
without a Swift build.

## Provenance

Generated by:

```sh
swift build --package-path app/RefabArtist
python3 scripts/functional_gate.py --generate
```

which runs, for every entry of `CASES` in `scripts/functional_gate.py`:

```sh
RefabArtist --headless-export --mode <mode> --format dxf \
    --fixture <source mesh> --thickness <t> --output <mode>__<label>/parts.dxf
```

with `<t>` = 3.0 for the Interlocked and Curve cases and 5.0 for the rest
(`MODE_THICKNESS_MM` in `scripts/functional_gate.py`), except 5.0 for the
`curve__*-5mm` and `interlocked__cracked-blob-5mm` cases and 3.0 for the
`folded__*-3mm`, `radial__*-3mm`, `stacked__cracked-blob-3mm` and
`stacked__corner-blocks-3mm` cases
(`CASE_THICKNESS_MM`), plus the case's `CASE_ARGS` (`--n-radial 6`
for the `radial__*-3mm` cases, the app's defaults; `--axis y` for the
`curve__*-y` and `curve__*-y-5mm` cases; `--joinery-type <joint>` for the
Folded Panels cases named after a joint type, such as
`folded__pyramid-gear-3mm`, the others using Tab joints;
`--folded-target-faces 250` for `folded__torus` and `folded__torus-3mm`;
`folded__gear` and `folded__gear-3mm` use the spur gear at full detail).
The Radial, Folded and Curve cases also pass
`--part-frames <mode>__<label>/parts.frames.json`, which writes where each
part of the DXF sits in the model, and for Folded Panels where each panel of
a net folds to (for SLOTS-MATE / PARTS-CLEAR).

The source meshes are the fixtures under `tests/fixtures/primitives/`,
`tests/fixtures/real-world/`, `tests/fixtures/organic/` (the lumpy blob and
the low-poly head), `tests/fixtures/stress/` (the hollow box),
`tests/fixtures/pathological/cube_self_intersecting.stl` (two overlapping
cubes, `radial__overlap-cubes*` and `curve__overlap-cubes*`),
`tests/fixtures/pathological/lumpy_blob_open_poles.stl` (the lumpy blob
cracked open at its poles, the `*__cracked-blob*` cases),
`tests/fixtures/pathological/torus_mixed_winding.stl` (the torus with a
third of its triangles wound inward, the `*__torus-mixed-winding*` cases),
`tests/fixtures/pathological/torus_inverted.stl` (the torus wound inside
out, the `*__torus-inverted*` cases; the gate checks both tori's parts
against the primitives torus),
`tests/fixtures/pathological/blocks_touching_at_corner.stl` (two blocks
meeting along one edge, the `stacked__corner-blocks*` cases) and
`tests/fixtures/square_pyramid_ascii.stl` (the square pyramid). The export is
deterministic: the same build writes the same bytes.

## Regenerating

When the exporter changes intentionally, regenerate with the command above,
run `python3 scripts/functional_gate.py`, and commit the updated files with
the change. A case whose result changes must be explained in the change
(and in `KNOWN_DEFECTS` if it now fails a gated invariant).

`functional_gate.json` is a generated run report and is not committed.
